lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters (spots) are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The spatial arrangement displays a higher density of centroids in the mid-lateral zone, with spatial frequency decreasing toward the posterior and dorsal edges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, particularly visible in the central and posterior sections of the visible flank, creating a grid-like pattern where blobs are centered within these vertical luminance channels.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-reflecting specular highlights on the upper edge and defined shadow along the lower boundary.
